dedupe_keys.name: railway operation inputs for eres capacity assessment

description: Can Wan and colleagues publish 2,688 model-ready railway operation cases for electrified rail-based energy-storage capacity assessment. The September 2026 deposit distributes twelve ZIP archives, each containing 224 MATLAB MAT cases, free under CC BY 4.0. Every case contains TrainConfiguration inputs and CaseMetadata describing its identifier, record count, train count, railway load and trajectory-sampling interval. The README states that the cases are self-contained and do not depend on shared record bundles. These inputs support charge, discharge and energy-capacity simulations using the companion ERES implementation. Geographical identities, operating dates and the derivation of individual timetable scenarios remain unknown from the dataset summary. Running the full calculation requires MATLAB, YALMIP and a licensed Gurobi installation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these prepared cases. Only the short README and metadata were read; the multi-gigabyte archives were not downloaded.
